title: OAGRC qualification record — a gate on an instrument, not a ballot
description: The result of a counterfactual qualification round. It ballots no proposition, adopts nothing, and confers no status on any text in it; it can only disqualify the ratification instrument that would have followed. A pass establishes ONLY that the sampled invocations distinguished the actual constraints from matched authority-expanding variants.

prompt_sha256.description: The instrument's identity. 'No retry' is enforced on this, not on the cohort name, so a fresh cohort cannot launder a second attempt.

answer_key.description: Which member was displayed as A and as B, fixed before collection.

registered_direction.description: The predicted direction per pair, registered before any sample was collected. A direction settled after seeing answers is not a prediction.

displayed_texts.description: The exact text shown as A and as B, so a quotation claim is checkable against what was on the card rather than against the source clause.

sources.description: EVERY raw sample file the result was computed from, like a finding_coding and not a single source: a record describing five parties that anchored only the first could drift from four of them unnoticed.
